body:
## Why
Some users want the board inside GitHub's own Projects UI. Labels stay canonical; the Project is a read surface.

## What
- `hkb init --project <number|new>`: link a Projects v2 board, create a single-select "Status" field matching the kb statuses, store ids in board.json.
- Dispatcher: after each status transition, one GraphQL mutation sets the item's Status field (add the issue to the project on first touch). Strictly one-way: drags in the Project UI change nothing and drift is repaired from labels on the next tick.
- Requires `gh auth refresh -s project`; `hkb doctor` checks the scope and says exactly that when missing.
- Off by default; document the extra write per transition.

## Done when
Transitions on this repo appear as column moves in a linked Project; deleting the Project breaks nothing.
title: Projects v2 mirror: opt-in, one-way status sync for people who live in GitHub Projects
